question.name: The City's Two Histories
question.text: Two scholars uncover contradictory accounts of the Secret City's past.

choices.label: Choose the account that seems most credible.

a1.text: Comparing the stories reveals a forgotten event.

a2.text: The scholars discover that each account was written to flatter its author.

a3.text: The village stages both versions as plays, and neither scholar likes the casting.

b1.text: A careful comparison of evidence produces a reliable record.

b2.text: A newly discovered inscription contradicts the chosen version, to everyone's embarrassment.

b3.text: The rejected scholar writes a scathing poem that becomes more popular than either history.
